svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/trades_readme.py from fault_response.yaml, the committed results and TS-001. Synthetic: an input to the trade study, not verification evidence; scores are preliminary drafts (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: A-LOSS = TS-001 supply-loss mode, hydraulic supply lost and torque to zero (sim/trades) · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · B-EHA = TS-001 alternative B with

electrohydraulic joint actuators (series-hybrid power) · B-EMA = TS-001 alternative B with electromechanical joint actuators (series-hybrid power) · B-ISOL = TS-001 supply-loss mode, battery isolated and torque to zero

(sim/trades) · B-SAG = TS-001 supply-loss mode, bus undervoltage with residual torque (sim/trades) · BMS = battery management system · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3

independent organisation) · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-DIST = protected power distribution · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) ·
SUS-M1-PWR-HPU = hydraulic power unit, accumulators and isolation (alternative A) · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · TS-nnn = architecture trade study
